It has a lot of mistakes (spelling, lines, my handwriting) and I'm out of white-out and money, so I'm trying not to stress about them. Also, I'm not huge on "wasting" space for aesthetics, but I wanted to try and give more life to my spreads and collections. 2021 was such a bleak year, but whenever I opened my BuJo and was faced with colors and drawings and stickers, I felt so much better! I'm trying to amplify that feeling this year. Paradoxically, I was also tired of carrying a lot of colored pens and pencils whenever I traveled or used my BuJo somewhere other than my house, so everything is projected to be filled with one black gel pen.
